summary: Phase V — Verified iteration 21: (a) Leadership Team CMS in Admin → Pages (add/edit/reorder/remove + save persistence + image upload admin-gating), (b) news/chapters/tiers route extractions intact (CRUD + admin-gating + duplicate-name handling), (c) critical regression smoke (/auth/login, /auth/me, /events, /members, /pages, /site-settings, /automated-emails). Backend pytest: 34/34 Phase V passing, plus 24/24 Phase T + 30/30 Phase U regression (88/88 total). Frontend Playwright E2E: 7/7 steps passed including end-to-end CMS flow (container + 2 seeded items + 'National board' eyebrow + 'Leadership Team' title; add 3rd term '2028-2030' → GET returns 3 items; edit term[0] persists; move-down-0 swaps order; remove + confirm dialog reduces to 2; /home renders home-leadership with both data-testids leadership-2024-2026 and leadership-2026-2028). Seed data restored to original 2 items via PUT /api/site-settings at end of UI test.
action_items: Continue server.py refactor — still 6497 lines after extracting news/chapters/tiers. Next candidates: /api/events (large), /api/members (large), /api/auth, /api/uploads (group all upload-image handlers under a single router).
Consider validating image_url in LeadershipItemIn (currently accepts any str; an invalid URL is silently saved and renders broken on Home). A simple HttpUrl or regex would catch typos.

/api/leadership/upload-image is gated by admin_tab_dep('pages') — confirm this matches admin_tab_dep used by LeadershipTeamAdmin save flow (it does: both 'pages'). Note: governor_manager and membership_manager sub-roles do NOT have 'pages' in their allowed tabs and therefore correctly get 403 on upload (not separately tested but matches the route-gating pattern).
critical_code_review_comments: routes/news.py, routes/chapters.py, routes/tiers.py all follow the same register(api, **deps) factory pattern — clean and consistent with the rest of the refactor (pages/site_settings/ai).

routes/site_settings.py LeadershipItemIn enforces term min_length=1 — good. image_url has only max_length=600, no URL validation. Empty image_url renders an on Home; consider adding a fallback or HttpUrl validation.

routes/site_settings.py make_default_settings() correctly seeds leadership_team_eyebrow/title/items; _ensure_site_settings() backfills missing fields onto existing docs without overwriting user changes (idempotent — verified across multiple GETs in the same test run).
frontend/LeadershipTeamAdmin.jsx uses window.confirm() inside removeItem — Playwright `page.on('dialog', accept)` handles it correctly. Code is small (~160 lines), no DRY issues.

frontend/Home.jsx now reads settings.leadership_team_items length and only renders the section if length>0 — clean conditional. Dynamic grid (md:grid-cols-2 / lg:grid-cols-3) is the correct UX for 2 vs 3+ items.
Image upload endpoint /api/leadership/upload-image is correctly gated (admin = 200, member = 403, anon = 401/403 — all verified). 1x1 PNG upload returns {url: ...} as expected.
Chapter duplicate-name detection uses case-insensitive regex match — works (verified by TestChaptersRoute.test_duplicate_name_returns_400).
MINOR: routes/news.py news_out() does not include 'updated_at' — only 'created_at'. NewsUpdateIn may set fields but caller can't see when the last update happened. Not blocking.

MINOR: routes/tiers.py register() signature omits iso/now_utc (correct — tier docs don't track timestamps), so the call site in server.py must pass only the right kwargs for each module. This is currently consistent.
